**Decision** Do not publish preview theme `77208`. Theme Check passing is not sufficient evidence that this preview is safe to publish. The supplied report only says static checks found no offenses; it did not run storefront rendering, app block rendering, Theme Editor behavior, interaction checks, or live verification. **Diagnosis** Observed fact: `templates/product.json` still contains all three saved blocks in order: - `heading_a` - `care_b` - `reviews_c` Observed fact: the preview renders only the heading. Observed fact: `sections/product-details.liquid` loops through `section.blocks`, but its `case block.type` only handles: ```liquid {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

``` There is no render path for: - `accordion` - app blocks, including the saved reviews block So the saved product details and reviews did not disappear from configuration. They are present in the saved JSON, but the section Liquid ignores those block types during rendering. **Scoped Repair** Edit only `sections/product-details.liquid`. Do not touch `templates/product.json`, merchant settings, app configuration, live theme `77200`, or unrelated `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour change. Proposed patch: ```liquid
{% for block in section.blocks %} {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% when 'accordion' %}
{{ block.settings.title | escape }}
{{ block.settings.body }}
{% when '@app' %}
{% render block %}
{% endcase %} {% endfor %}
``` This keeps the change narrow: it adds rendering for block types already declared in the section schema and already present in the saved product template. **Supporting Evidence** Observed facts: - Preview theme: unpublished `77208`. - Live theme: `77200`. - Branch: `review/product-blocks`. - Saved product template includes heading, accordion, and reviews app block. - Preview observation says heading renders, Care accordion and reviews block do not. - Section schema declares `heading`, `accordion`, and `@app`. - Section Liquid only renders `heading`. Inference: - The missing accordion and review block are caused by incomplete Liquid rendering logic, not by missing saved configuration. - The review block may have a second dependency on the review app installation, entitlement, or assets, but the current Liquid would suppress it regardless. **Acceptance Checks** Before publication, verify on unpublished preview `77208`: - Heading renders with saved text: “Made for everyday use”. - Care accordion renders in the configured order after the heading. - Accordion summary renders “Care”. - Accordion body renders “Wipe with a soft cloth.” - Reviews app block render is attempted in the configured order after Care. - Theme Editor can add, remove, reorder, and duplicate heading, accordion, and app blocks without losing saved settings. - `block.shopify_attributes` are present enough for editor block selection. - Mobile and desktop layouts do not overlap or hide content. - Keyboard users can focus and toggle the native accordion. - No new console errors attributable to this section. - If the review block still does not appear after `{% render block %}`, separate diagnosis is needed for app install, entitlement, app assets, or network/runtime errors. **Uncertainties** Unknown: - Whether the fictional reviews app is installed and entitled on this preview. - Whether app assets load successfully. - Whether there are network or console errors. - Whether other product templates use this section. - Whether the supplied snapshot matches the latest local tree. **Work Status** State supported by the packet: diagnosed and proposed only. Not edited, not previewed after patch, not uploaded, not published, not live, and not verified. Authorization explicitly allows diagnosis and proposed patch only, with no permission to edit live configuration, replace merchant settings, upload, or publish.
